title: Addendum: Challis and Manhattan Transfer
summary: Gitler adds that Challis worked on a Manhattan Transfer Atlantic album because they thought he arranged Sunny Disposition.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: Ira Gitler with an addendum to the Bill Challis interview. Bill told me that in recent years he worked with the vocal group, Manhattan Transfer, on one of their albums for Atlantic. I don't know which one it was. But the reason it came about was that they thought he had done the original arrangement of Sunny Disposition back in the '20s. He hadn't, but he did become involved with them in this recording project.
